title: Technician Foundations
audience: Beginners, including people with no amateur-radio experience.

labs.title: What Is Radio?
labs.description: Explore frequency, wavelength, signals, noise, Hz/kHz/MHz, and basic receiver behavior.

labs.title: Your First Radio
labs.description: Frequency selection, volume, squelch, simplex operation, memories, and basic radio controls.

labs.title: Repeaters
labs.description: Repeater input/output frequencies, offsets, tones, range, and basic repeater operation.

labs.title: Bands & Privileges
labs.description: Amateur bands, Technician privileges, operating scenarios, and choosing an appropriate frequency.

labs.title: Electricity Without the Textbook
labs.description: Voltage, current, resistance, power, and an interactive introduction to Ohm's law.

labs.title: Antennas & SWR
labs.description: Frequency, wavelength, antenna length, resonance, SWR, and troubleshooting.

labs.title: Propagation & Range
labs.description: Line of sight, terrain, antenna height, VHF/UHF behavior, introductory HF propagation, and repeaters.

labs.title: First Field Operation
labs.description: An integrated scenario: choose equipment, frequency and band, antenna, operating method, and proper procedure.
